cmd.servers: Manage the CS2 servers this Discord server tracks
cmd.servers.add: Track a CS2 server and post its map changes in a channel
cmd.servers.min_players: Only post map changes when at least this many players are on
cmd.map: Show a server's current map and player count
cmd.players: Show who is playing on a server
cmd.notify: Get alerted when a map you like comes up
cmd.notify.add: Alert me when this map comes up (wildcards like de_* work)
cmd.notify.remove: Remove one of my map alerts
cmd.notify.mode: Choose how I get alerts: DM or mention in the channel
cmd.invite: Add Shiron to your own Discord server
opt.channel: Channel for map-change posts (default: this channel)
opt.map: Map name, e.g. de_dust2 or de_*
err.internal: Something went wrong. Please try again later.
err.guild_only: This command only works inside a Discord server.
err.no_servers: No CS2 servers are tracked here yet. An admin can add one with `/servers add`.
err.pick_server: This Discord server tracks several CS2 servers. Pick one with the `server` option.
err.server_not_found: That server isn't tracked here. Pick one from the list.
err.too_many_servers: You can track at most %d CS2 servers per Discord server.
err.bad_address: That address isn't valid. Use a public IP or hostname, e.g. `1.2.3.4:27015`.
err.no_channel_perms: I can't post in <#%s>. Give me View Channel, Send Messages and Embed Links there.
err.no_response: %s didn't answer. Check the address and that the server is online.
err.bad_pattern: That map name isn't valid. Example: `de_dust2` or `de_*`.
err.too_many_notifies: You can have at most %d map alerts per Discord server.
err.already_notify: You already have an alert for `%s` on that server.
err.notify_not_found: That alert doesn't exist. Pick one from the list.
help.text:
**Shiron** tracks CS2 servers.

**Everyone**
`/map` – current map and players
`/players` – who is playing
`/notify add` – get alerted when a map comes up
`/notify list`, `/notify remove`, `/notify mode` – manage your alerts
`/invite` – add Shiron to your server

**Admins (Manage Server)**
`/servers add` – track a CS2 server and post map changes
`/servers list`, `/servers remove`
`/servers min-players` – only post when enough players are on
invite.reply: Add Shiron to your Discord server: %s
servers.added: Now tracking **%s** (`%s`). Map changes go to <#%s> (minimum players: %d).
servers.min_set: %s: map changes are now posted when at least %d players are on.
players.hidden: This server doesn't share its player list.
post.title: 🗺️ Map changed: %s
notify.added: I'll alert you when `%s` comes up on %s (by %s).
notify.none: You have no map alerts here. Alerts are delivered by %s.
notify.mode_set: Alerts will now be delivered by %s.
